name: Corruption Town
source: Control Agnes as she tries to resist the temptations of the lecherous men around her. Manage the Limping Duck, a shady inn where the wretched go to have a drink and ogle Agnes! It's your choice to help her succumb to corruption or fight it!
translation: 操控艾格尼丝，看她如何努力抵御身边好色男人们的重重诱惑。经营“跛脚鸭旅店”——一家三教九流的无赖们前来买醉、肆意偷瞄艾格尼丝的阴暗酒馆！究竟是推她沉沦堕落，还是助她坚守清白，一切由你决定！
